description: Tickwatch is a tiny, server-side Minecraft mod that records each player's playtime, kills, and deaths and stores them in a plain JSON file per world. It runs on both Fabric and NeoForge.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-18 (d1387ddf) (47 classes, 84 members). Not run yet.
